Drawer

Drawers slide in from the edge of the screen to surface navigation, filters or secondary content without leaving the current page.

Left & Right Drawer

Drawers are positioned with .zak-drawer-start (left) and .zak-drawer-end (right). Open with data-zak-drawer="#id" and close with data-zak-drawer-close.

<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" data-zak-drawer="#drawerLeft">Open Left</button>

<div class="zak-drawer zak-drawer-start" id="drawerLeft">

        <div class="zak-drawer-header">
            <h3 style="margin:0; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600;">Filters</h3>

        <div class="zak-drawer-footer">
            <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-secondary" data-zak-drawer-close>Reset</button>
            <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" data-zak-drawer-close>Apply</button>
        </div>
    </aside>
</div>

Top & Bottom Drawer

Use .zak-drawer-top and .zak-drawer-bottom for horizontal drawers that drop or rise into view.

Search

Press Escape or click outside to close this drawer.

Quick Actions

Drawer with Header

The header area carries a title and dismiss button; the footer holds primary actions. The body scrolls when content overflows.

Drawer with Overlay

By default drawers add a dark overlay. Clicking the overlay or pressing Escape dismisses the drawer and restores page scroll.

Settings

The dimmed backdrop focuses attention on the panel. It also blocks interaction with the page underneath.

Drawer Sizes

The default rail width is 20rem for side drawers. Override width (or height for top/bottom) inline on the .zak-drawer-content element.

Small

16rem wide drawer.

Medium

24rem wide drawer.

Large

32rem wide drawer.

Push Drawer vs Overlay Drawer

An overlay drawer floats above the page with a scrim (default). A push drawer stays inside the document flow and shifts the content beside it. Try the interactive push demo.

Mailbox
Inbox Starred Sent Drafts Trash

The push drawer resizes the content area instead of overlaying it.

HTML
// Overlay (default) — floats above the page
zak.drawer.open('#overlayDrawer');   // adds scrim, locks scroll

// Push — no overlay, sits in the layout flow
document.getElementById('pushDemoBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    document.getElementById('pushDemo').classList.toggle('docs-sidebar__category--collapsed');
});

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
/* Class Summary */
.zak-drawer              /* Fixed container (hidden until active) */
.zak-drawer-active       /* Added by JS to slide the drawer in */
.zak-drawer-overlay      /* JS-created scrim */
.zak-drawer-content      /* The sliding surface panel */
.zak-drawer-header       /* Title row */
.zak-drawer-body         /* Scrollable content */
.zak-drawer-footer       /* Action row */
.zak-drawer-start        /* Rail on the left  (width 20rem) */
.zak-drawer-end          /* Rail on the right (width 20rem) */
.zak-drawer-top          /* Panel at the top (height 20rem) */
.zak-drawer-bottom       /* Panel at the bottom (min-height 12rem) */

/* Variables used */
--zak-z-modal            /* Drawer z-index */
--zak-z-backdrop         /* Overlay z-index */
--zak-backdrop-bg        /* Scrim color */
--zak-shadow-xl          /* Panel shadow */
--zak-transition-slow    /* Slide duration */

JavaScript

HTML
// Data attributes (automatic)
//   data-zak-drawer="#id"    open the drawer
//   data-zak-drawer-close     close the closest .zak-drawer

// Programmatic API
zak.drawer.open('#myDrawer');
zak.drawer.close('#myDrawer');
zak.drawer.toggle('#myDrawer');

// The drawer listens for Escape and disables body scroll.
// Events fire on the drawer element:
drawer.addEventListener('zak:open', function () { console.log('opened'); });
drawer.addEventListener('zak:close', function () { console.log('closed'); });

Accessibility

  • Use a heading inside .zak-drawer-header so the drawer purpose is announced.
  • Give the dismiss button an aria-label="Close".
  • Focus moves into the drawer when it opens (focus the input for search drawers) and returns to the trigger on close.
  • Escape closes the drawer. The overlay is clickable to close, which is standard for drawer UX.
  • Set role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" on the content region when the drawer is a modal scrim.
  • Keep footer actions at least 44px tall for touch targets.
